name: Coordinator Asks User a Clarifying Question
description:
Fires when a coordinator loop calls decide(action=ask_user, reason=<user-facing prose>). The persona contract overloads `reason` for this action: it carries the prose to deliver to the user, NOT an internal log. This rule stamps coordinator.clarification.question for audit. Typed response delivery is owned by agentic-dispatch; beta.161 reserves user.response.> for agentic.user_response/v1 and this rule deliberately has no flat publish action.

Long-term: the `reason`-as-prose overload is a stepping stone. A structured user_question field would let the prose and internal-log reason coexist. Until then, persona prose disambiguates per-action.

metadata.delivery_contract: agentic-dispatch owns typed agentic.user_response/v1 delivery. This rule owns only the clarification audit triple and must not publish a flat rule envelope into user.response.>.
metadata.reason_overload_note: Persona contract (10-decision-contract.md) overloads `reason` for action=ask_user — it carries user-facing prose. Other action values keep `reason` as the internal log convention. Upstream PR target: structured `user_question` field on decide tool.
metadata.audit_contract: The coordinator.clarification.question triple remains the durable audit fact for the question prose.
